description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {1}{U}.
Spider-Man India and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.
